description: Buy a phone number on the brand's own Twilio or Telnyx account (the provider bills it monthly at its own price). phoneNumber comes from search_phone_numbers. connectInbox (default true) points its texts at the Hermoso Inbox and its calls at Hermoso's call handling. Without confirm:true nothing is bought and the answer says what would happen; call again with confirm:true once the user agrees. Free in credits. Needs Twilio or Telnyx connected (Connectors, or connect_connector).
